name: Red Wing Heritage
notes: redwingheritage.com redirects to redwingshoes.com/heritage/. Live, selling Heritage boots (Iron Ranger $359.99, Classic Chelsea $299.99), leather goods and apparel (shirts, hoodies); no jackets or outerwear, so it doesn't sell coats-jackets and is left out of that category (https://www.redwingshoes.com/heritage/).

Iron Ranger #8000 and Clara #3405 product pages: Goodyear leather welt, resoleable, Made in USA; repairs at the Red Wing, Minnesota, manufacturing facility; Iron Ranger sizes 6–13 (D), Clara 5–12 (B, D) (https://www.redwingshoes.com/mens/heritage/iron-ranger/iron-ranger-08000.html?currency=USD).
Returns: online orders back within 30 days of receipt, by mail or at any Red Wing store, free return shipping (https://www.redwingshoes.com/contact-us/returns.html?currency=USD).
Shipping: free standard shipping over $50 when signed in to an account; guest standard shipping $10 (https://www.redwingshoes.com/contact-us/shipping.html?currency=USD).

prices.note: Heritage listings, men's 56 items (42 boots) and women's 33 (29 boots, https://www.redwingshoes.com/womens/heritage/?currency=USD), none marked down. Low: Weekender Chelsea $279.99; Blacksmith $329.99; Iron Ranger $359.99; Women's Heeled Boot (Clara) $359.99; high: Engineer $549.99.
